title: Conflict
subtitle: 「衝突／爭執／分歧／對立」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中自然的替代表達？
description: 「衝突／爭執／分歧／對立」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中自然的替代表達？

words.note: 和 conflict 很接近，尤其指雙方對某件事有明確爭議。
words.example: The two companies are involved in a dispute over the contract.
words.exampleZh: 兩家公司因合約問題發生爭議。

exercises.original: The two companies are in conflict over who owns the technology.
exercises.zh: 兩家公司因技術所有權問題發生爭議。
exercises.upgrade: The two companies are in a dispute over who owns the technology.

options.explanation: 有明確具體爭點——技術所有權——很適合 dispute over...。
也可能成立，但較弱，更像意見不同；此句涉及權利歸屬爭議。
表示關係緊張，不一定有明確爭議事項。
辯論可以理性進行，未必是爭議。
形容詞／過去分詞，不能直接放在 a 後作名詞。

exercises.original: The neighbours have been in conflict over the boundary for months.
exercises.zh: 鄰居因邊界問題爭執了幾個月。
exercises.upgrade: The neighbours have been in a dispute over the boundary for months.

options.explanation: boundary dispute 是非常常見搭配。
較像一次正面衝突，不如 dispute 突出長期爭點。
表示摩擦，但沒有 boundary ownership 的具體法律／事實爭議感。
競爭關係，不等於邊界爭議。
動名詞形式不能自然放在 a 後。

exercises.original: The contract conflict was finally settled out of court.
exercises.zh: 合約爭議最終在庭外解決。
exercises.upgrade: The contract dispute was finally settled out of court.

options.explanation: settled out of court 強烈指向法律／商業爭議。
太一般，法律語境下不如 dispute 精確。
緊張關係不能通常用 settled out of court。

words.note: 表示雙方看法不同，通常比 conflict 較弱。
words.example: There was a disagreement about how the project should be managed.
words.exampleZh: 大家對項目應如何管理出現分歧。

exercises.original: There was a conflict about how the project should be managed.
exercises.zh: 大家對項目應如何管理出現分歧。
exercises.upgrade: There was a disagreement about how the project should be managed.

options.explanation: 重點是不同意見，沒有顯示敵意或正式爭議。
也可用，但稍強，通常表示更明確、持續的爭執。
表示直接對抗，強度過高。
危機不是意見分歧本身。
動名詞，不能和 a 這樣搭配。

exercises.original: The committee members had a conflict over the wording of the report, but the discussion remained calm.
exercises.zh: 委員會成員對報告措辭有分歧，但討論仍然平靜。
exercises.upgrade: The committee members had a disagreement over the wording of the report.

options.explanation: discussion remained calm 表示只是意見不合。
動詞過去式，不能接在 a 後。

exercises.original: Their conflict was mainly about which design looked better.
exercises.zh: 他們的分歧主要是對哪個設計較好看有不同意見。
exercises.upgrade: Their disagreement was mainly about which design looked better.

options.explanation: 審美意見不同通常只是 disagreement。
表示關係裂痕，過度強烈。
difference of opinion 可以，但單獨 difference 太泛，不等於 conflict。

words.note: 表示雙方直接、明顯地發生衝突。
words.example: The two groups clashed over the proposed changes.
words.exampleZh: 兩個群體因擬議改革發生衝突。

exercises.original: The two groups came into conflict over the proposed changes.
exercises.zh: 兩個群體因擬議改革發生正面衝突。
exercises.upgrade: The two groups came into a clash over the proposed changes.

options.explanation: 可能只是緊張，未必爆發衝突。

exercises.original: The meeting ended in conflict between management and staff.
exercises.zh: 會議最終演變成管理層與員工之間的衝突。
exercises.upgrade: The meeting ended in a clash between management and staff.

options.explanation: ended in + direct opposing groups 很自然。
表示緊張，但未必有實際交鋒。
表示反對立場，不一定發生正面衝突。

exercises.original: The personality conflict between the two managers affected the whole team.
exercises.zh: 兩名經理之間的性格衝突影響整個團隊。
exercises.upgrade: The personality clash between the two managers affected the whole team.

options.explanation: personality clash 是固定常見搭配。
通常需要一個具體爭點。
也可能存在，但不是 personality clash 的標準替代。
概念接近，但較抽象，沒有 clash 的互動衝突感。

words.note: 指直接、往往緊張或敵對的對抗。
words.example: The argument developed into a confrontation between the two managers.
words.exampleZh: 爭論演變成兩名經理之間的正面衝突。

exercises.original: The argument developed into a direct conflict between the two managers.
exercises.zh: 爭論演變成兩名經理之間的正面對抗。
exercises.upgrade: The argument developed into a confrontation between the two managers.

options.explanation: direct + argument escalating 很適合 confrontation。
通常是長期摩擦，不一定是一次面對面對抗。

exercises.original: Police tried to prevent conflict between the rival groups outside the stadium.
exercises.zh: 警方試圖防止球場外兩個敵對群體發生正面衝突。
exercises.upgrade: Police tried to prevent a confrontation between the rival groups.

options.explanation: 警方 prevent + rival groups，通常指直接衝突。
競爭關係本身不等於事件。
警方也可防止 tension escalating，但不是「一次衝突事件」。

exercises.original: She wanted to resolve the issue without creating an open conflict.
exercises.zh: 她希望解決問題，而不引發公開對抗。
exercises.upgrade: She wanted to resolve the issue without creating an open confrontation.

options.explanation: 意見不同可能已經存在。
可以存在而未升級成公開對抗。

words.note: 較正式，表示人群或組織內部缺乏和諧。
words.example: The decision caused discord within the committee.
words.exampleZh: 這項決定在委員會內部造成不和。

exercises.original: The decision caused conflict within the committee and damaged trust.
exercises.zh: 這項決定在委員會內造成不和，並破壞信任。
exercises.upgrade: The decision caused discord within the committee.

options.explanation: damaged trust 表示關係失和，不只是一次意見不同。
很接近，但 discord 更突出內部不和。

exercises.original: Years of internal conflict weakened the organization.
exercises.zh: 多年的內部不和削弱了這個組織。
exercises.upgrade: Years of internal discord weakened the organization.

options.explanation: internal discord 是正式自然搭配。
通常涉及某個具體爭點。
偏一次或多次直接對抗。
競爭未必造成內部分裂。

exercises.original: Family conflict over money continued for years.
exercises.zh: 家庭因金錢問題多年不和。
exercises.upgrade: Family discord over money continued for years.

options.explanation: 長期家庭關係不和非常適合。
雖是名詞，但更常指不協調／不一致，不如 family discord 自然。

words.note: 表示持續的小衝突、緊張或關係磨擦。
words.example: There has been growing friction between the two departments.
words.exampleZh: 兩個部門之間的摩擦日益增加。

exercises.original: There has been growing conflict between the two departments over resources.
exercises.zh: 兩個部門因資源問題摩擦日益增加。
exercises.upgrade: There has been growing friction between the two departments.

options.explanation: growing + 部門間長期小衝突很典型。
通常是直接爆發的對抗。
只說意見不同，不如 friction 表達持續關係磨擦。

exercises.original: Minor conflicts between the teams gradually damaged cooperation.
exercises.zh: 兩隊之間的小摩擦逐漸破壞合作。
exercises.upgrade: Friction between the teams gradually damaged cooperation.

options.explanation: minor + gradually 正是小摩擦持續累積的語境。
太嚴重、太正式，通常指長期而重大的社會或政治紛爭。
通常指實際敵對或武裝行動，強度過高。
較像一次明顯的正面對抗，不如 friction 表達逐漸累積的小衝突。
表示反對立場，不一定涉及日常合作中的摩擦。
也可表示意見不合，但 minor conflicts 且「逐漸破壞合作」更自然地指持續 friction。

exercises.original: The policy created conflict between senior staff and newer employees, but no open argument occurred.
exercises.zh: 政策在資深員工與新員工之間造成摩擦，但沒有公開爭吵。
exercises.upgrade: The policy created friction between senior staff and newer employees.

options.explanation: no open argument occurred 表示只是持續緊張和小摩擦。
通常有明確爭點和爭執。
表示「無摩擦的」，意思相反。

words.note: 表示衝突尚未完全爆發，但雙方關係緊張。
words.example: Tension between the two teams increased after the argument.
words.exampleZh: 爭論後，兩個團隊之間的緊張關係加劇。

exercises.original: Conflict between the two teams increased after the accusation, although they had not argued openly.
exercises.zh: 指控後兩隊關係更加緊張，雖然尚未公開爭吵。
exercises.upgrade: Tension between the two teams increased after the accusation.

options.explanation: 尚未公開衝突，但氣氛和關係已緊張。
形容詞，不能直接作主語名詞。

exercises.original: There was obvious conflict in the room before the negotiations began.
exercises.zh: 談判開始前，房間裡有明顯的緊張氣氛。
exercises.upgrade: There was obvious tension in the room before the negotiations began.

options.explanation: in the room 很自然地描述氣氛。
是意見差異，不是氣氛本身。

exercises.original: The conflict between the neighbours was noticeable even when they were not speaking.
exercises.zh: 即使鄰居沒有交談，也能感受到他們之間的緊張關係。
exercises.upgrade: The tension between the neighbours was noticeable even when they were not speaking.

options.explanation: 不用言語也可感受到 tension。
通常需要一個明確爭議事項。
立場對立，不一定能從沉默中感受到。

words.note: 較正式、較強烈，常表示持續、嚴重的社會、政治或群體衝突。
words.example: The region suffered years of political strife.
words.exampleZh: 該地區經歷多年政治紛爭。

exercises.original: The region suffered years of political conflict.
exercises.zh: 該地區經歷多年政治紛爭。
exercises.upgrade: The region suffered years of political strife.

options.explanation: 多年、嚴重、政治性衝突很自然。
可能存在，但不足以表達 years of serious conflict。

exercises.original: Internal conflict divided the movement into rival factions.
exercises.zh: 內部紛爭令這場運動分裂成敵對派系。
exercises.upgrade: Internal strife divided the movement into rival factions.

options.explanation: 分裂成敵對派系表示衝突嚴重、持續。

exercises.original: The country emerged from a decade of civil conflict.
exercises.zh: 這個國家走出十年的內部紛爭。
exercises.upgrade: The country emerged from a decade of civil strife.

options.explanation: civil strife 是正式常見搭配。
不足以形容國家層面的十年紛爭。
競爭可能存在，但不是持續衝突總稱。

words.note: 當 conflict 強調兩方立場彼此相反時可自然改寫。
words.example: The proposal faced strong opposition from local residents.
words.exampleZh: 這項提案遭到當地居民強烈反對。

exercises.original: The proposal created conflict because local residents strongly opposed it.
exercises.zh: 這項提案因當地居民強烈反對而形成對立。
exercises.upgrade: The proposal faced strong opposition from local residents.

options.explanation: 原句直接說 strongly opposed，最精確。
只是意見不同，沒有強調反對立場。
形容詞／過去分詞，不能作名詞。

exercises.original: There is strong conflict between supporters and critics of the plan.
exercises.zh: 支持者和反對者對這個計劃形成強烈對立。
exercises.upgrade: There is strong opposition to the plan.

options.explanation: 當重點是「反對方案」時最自然。
可有反方，但不等於 opposition 本身。

exercises.original: The reform met conflict from several professional groups.
exercises.zh: 改革遭到幾個專業團體反對。
exercises.upgrade: The reform met opposition from several professional groups.

options.explanation: meet opposition 是固定自然搭配。

words.note: 當 conflict 指兩個目標、規則、要求或利益無法同時成立時很精確。
words.example: There is an incompatibility between the two sets of requirements.
words.exampleZh: 兩套要求之間存在不相容之處。

exercises.original: There is a conflict between the two sets of technical requirements because they cannot both be satisfied.
exercises.zh: 兩套技術要求互相衝突，無法同時滿足。
exercises.upgrade: There is an incompatibility between the two sets of technical requirements.

options.explanation: cannot both be satisfied 明確表示兩者不相容。
可比喻，但不如 incompatibility 精確。
形容詞，不能接在 an 後作名詞。

exercises.original: The conflict between her work schedule and childcare responsibilities made the arrangement impossible.
exercises.zh: 工作時間和照顧孩子的責任互相衝突，令安排無法實行。
exercises.upgrade: The incompatibility between her work schedule and childcare responsibilities made the arrangement impossible.

options.explanation: 兩個要求無法同時配合。

exercises.original: The conflict between the two software systems caused repeated errors.
exercises.zh: 兩套軟件系統不相容，導致反覆出錯。
exercises.upgrade: The incompatibility between the two software systems caused repeated errors.

options.explanation: 技術系統不能正常配合時最精確。
形容詞；可說 conflicting systems/requirements，但此處需要名詞。

words.note: 當 conflict 指實際軍事或武裝對抗時很接近。
words.example: Hostilities resumed after the ceasefire collapsed.
words.exampleZh: 停火協議失效後，敵對行動重新開始。

exercises.original: Armed conflict resumed after the ceasefire collapsed.
exercises.zh: 停火協議失效後，武裝敵對行動重新開始。
exercises.upgrade: Hostilities resumed after the ceasefire collapsed.

options.explanation: ceasefire + resumed 是典型軍事搭配。
可以在戰前存在，但不是武裝行動本身。
可以是外交爭議，不一定武裝。

exercises.original: The agreement brought an end to the conflict between the armed groups.
exercises.zh: 協議結束了武裝團體之間的敵對行動。
exercises.upgrade: The agreement brought an end to hostilities between the armed groups.

options.explanation: 複數 hostilities 常指實際軍事敵對行動。
即使 hostilities 結束，tension 可能仍存在。
單數可表示敵意，但 end hostilities 更準確指武裝行動。

exercises.original: International mediators tried to stop the conflict before more fighting began.
exercises.zh: 國際調解人員試圖制止敵對行動，以免更多戰鬥爆發。
exercises.upgrade: International mediators tried to stop the hostilities.

options.explanation: more fighting 明確指武裝敵對。
政治反對不一定有戰鬥。

words.note: 表示長期或嚴重衝突造成的關係裂痕。
words.example: The dispute created a deep rift between the two families.
words.exampleZh: 這場爭執令兩個家庭之間出現嚴重裂痕。

exercises.original: The long-running conflict created a deep division between the two families.
exercises.zh: 長期衝突令兩個家庭之間出現深刻裂痕。
exercises.upgrade: The long-running conflict created a deep rift between the two families.

options.explanation: deep division + 長期關係破裂正是 rift。
關係緊張但未必已破裂。
不是這裡需要的名詞形式。

exercises.original: The dispute caused a conflict within the political party that lasted for years.
exercises.zh: 這場爭議令政黨內部出現持續多年的裂痕。
exercises.upgrade: The dispute caused a rift within the political party.

options.explanation: 持續多年、內部分裂，最適合 rift。
可以長期存在，但不一定造成結構性分裂。

exercises.original: Their conflict eventually damaged the friendship beyond repair.
exercises.zh: 他們的衝突最終令友誼產生無法修補的裂痕。
exercises.upgrade: Their conflict eventually created a rift in the friendship.

options.explanation: beyond repair 顯示關係已嚴重破裂。
只是緊張，未必不可修復。
通常沒有這麼強的關係後果。
形容人的內心矛盾，不是關係裂痕。

falseSynonyms.zh: 爭論 ≠ 所有 conflict argument 通常指言語上的爭論； conflict 可以完全沒有口頭爭吵，也可指政治、利益或軍事衝突。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They had an argument about money. There is a long-term conflict between their business interests.

falseSynonyms.zh: 競爭 ≠ 衝突 competition 可以在規則內和平進行。 衝突則通常有對立、矛盾或摩擦。
不同 ≠ 分歧／衝突 兩件事不同並不代表彼此 conflict。
危機 ≠ 衝突 conflict 可以造成 crisis，但 crisis 也可由經濟、健康、自然災害等原因造成。
暴力 ≠ 所有衝突 某些 conflict 會有 violence，但很多衝突只是意見或利益對立。
辯論 ≠ 衝突 debate 可以是有規則、理性的意見交換，不一定有敵對性。
詞形與意思不同 - conflict = 名詞／動詞，衝突 - conflicting = 形容詞，互相矛盾的 - conflicted = 形容詞，內心矛盾的
詞形不同 - dispute = 爭議／爭論 - disputed = 有爭議的 - disputable = 可以爭論的／有疑問的
